description: This file defines the Entity Framework Core DbContext implementation 'ConduitContext' for the Conduit project. It sets up database sets for domain entities, configures model relationships and constraints, and manages database transactions.

classes.name: ConduitContext
classes.description: The Entity Framework Core DbContext class that manages database access for core domain entities and transaction handling.

methods.name: ConduitContext
methods.description: Constructor initializing the DbContext with options.

methods.name: OnModelCreating
methods.description: Configures entity relationships, primary keys, and delete behaviors.

methods.name: BeginTransaction
methods.description: Starts a new database transaction if none is active.

methods.name: CommitTransaction
methods.description: Commits the current transaction, with error handling and cleanup.

methods.name: RollbackTransaction
methods.description: Rolls back and disposes of the current transaction.
